licence.renewalWindow.value: Complete document submission and payment before the expiry date. Licences shall be renewed no later than 30 days after expiry. No advance window found.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), DWTC Free Zone, renewal window (renewal guide (August 2025) and Free Zone Rules rule 12, CONFIRMED); https://media.dwtc.com/Free-Zone-Rules-and-Regulations-V10.pdf ; https://media.dwtc.com/Free-Zone-Rules-and-Regulations-V12.pdf ; https://media.dwtc.com/License-Renewal-August-2025.pdf

licence.renewsTogether.value: The lease is renewed first, where applicable. The establishment card is renewed after the renewed licence is issued. Also required: an FTA tax registration certificate or a declaration letter, and a UBO declaration if anything changed.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), DWTC Free Zone, renews together (renewal guide (August 2025), CONFIRMED); https://media.dwtc.com/License-Renewal-August-2025.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: Renewal is due no later than 30 days after expiry, otherwise a penalty applies. Separate monthly penalties apply to the licence and to the establishment card. If the licence is not renewed, all employee and dependant visas must be cancelled or transferred and cards returned; anyone not cancelled or transferred is reported as absconding. Non-renewal also invalidates the Lease, and all dues and lease issues must be settled. The Authority may revoke, cancel or suspend a licence on 30 days' written notice for failing to submit renewal documents or pay fees.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), DWTC Free Zone, late renewal (Free Zone Rules rule 12 and section 8, and the renewal guide (August 2025), CONFIRMED; amounts left out); https://media.dwtc.com/Free-Zone-Rules-and-Regulations-V10.pdf ; https://media.dwtc.com/Free-Zone-Rules-and-Regulations-V12.pdf ; https://media.dwtc.com/License-Renewal-August-2025.pdf
